items.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Meningococcal Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
items.summary: There is an outbreak of meningococcal disease in the Mangembo Health Zone of Kongo Central Province. The best way to protect yourself is to get meningococcal vaccination.

items.title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Suriname
items.summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Suriname. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.
